title: O come let us adore
lyrics_original: O come let us adore Him (2) – Christ the Lord
For He alone is worthy – Christ the Lord
He's the lily of the Valley (2) – Christ the Lord

bible_verses.english: saying with a loud voice, “Worthy is the Lamb who has been slain to receive the power, riches, wisdom, strength, honor, glory, and blessing!”

Therefore God also highly exalted him, and gave to him the name which is above every name; that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of those in heaven, those on earth, and those under the earth, and that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
I am a rose of Sharon, a lily of the valleys.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, I come before You today with a heart full of wonder and gratitude. You alone are worthy of all my love, worship, and adoration. Thank You for being my gentle Lily of the Valley, bringing grace and beauty into my daily life. Help me to keep my eyes fixed on You, honoring Your name in everything I do. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: When we sing "O Come Let Us Adore Him," we step into an invitation that echoes through all eternity. Jesus is not only our exalted Lord who alone is worthy of our highest praise, but He is also the pure, tender Lily of the Valley who meets us in life’s low places. As you open your heart to Him today, pause to behold His beauty and majesty. Let your spirit rest in His goodness and offer Him the humble devotion He so deeply deserves.
